originalTitle: Apple’s stock could underperform, especially without an ‘all-glass’ iPhone, this analyst warns
summary: A Jefferies analyst says that it may be harder than it looks for Apple to roll out dramatically more expensive devices in a bid to boost profitability.
content: A Jefferies analyst says that it may be harder than it looks for Apple to roll out dramatically more expensive devices in a bid to boost profitability.
chineseTitle: 这位分析师警告称，苹果股价可能会表现不佳，尤其是如果没有“全玻璃”iPhone
chineseSummary: 杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 的一位分析师表示，苹果推出价格大幅上涨的设备以提高盈利能力可能比想象中更困难。

whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
